source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The notification module ignores successful and unlisted status codes and maps selected network failures to hostname-bearing text. CalDAV passes that stream result separately from its DAV error and HTTP details. The original response exposes numeric streamStatus; accepted later code exposes streamError and forwards its result. Keep those roles and representation phases distinct: an HTTP/DAV failure alone does not establish a transport alert, and not every operation forwards a stream result.
title: Calendar connection alerts classify stream results separately from DAV and HTTP errors
